import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 3, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 3, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

STEM = 48
COLF = 32
TW = 32
LH = 48
LF = 16
MH = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        C = int(spec.in_channels)
        Z = self.Z
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(C, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COLF, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COLF, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.lin_in = nn.Conv2d(C + Z + 8, LH, 1)
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(TW, LH, 1)
        self.lin2 = nn.Conv2d(LH, LF, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * LF, MH, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(MH, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * TW + 2 * LF, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

        lay = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        below = torch.cat([torch.zeros_like(lay[:, :, :1]), lay[:, :, :-1]], dim=2)
        cur = lay.permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
        bel = below.permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
        col = obs.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, C, Y, X)
        eye = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([col, eye, cur, bel], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, C + Z + 8, Y, X)

        ctx = self.ctx(f)
        h = self.lin_in(inp).view(B, Z, LH, Y, X) + ctx.unsqueeze(1)
        h = F.relu(h).reshape(B * Z, LH, Y, X)
        p = self.lin2(h)

        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            o = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1))))
            res.append(o.view(B, Z, Y, X))
        sc = torch.stack(res, dim=1)
        place = torch.logsumexp(sc, dim=2).flatten(1)

        pz = p.view(B, Z, LF, Y, X)
        gin = torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)),
                         pz.mean((1, 3, 4)), pz.amax(dim=(1, 3, 4))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(gin)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.95, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

CF = 48
HK = 16
H1 = 48
H2 = 24
AG = 32
TW = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        n = len(self.fps)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(C, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, CF, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.hcode = nn.Conv2d(CF, HK, 1)
        self.cellp = nn.Conv2d(CF, H1, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(CF, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.ctxp = nn.Conv2d(TW, H1, 1)
        self.fpp = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HK, H1, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.w2 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H1, H2, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.agg = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * H2, AG, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(AG, 1, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * (CF + TW), 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        hc = self.hcode(s)
        cp = self.cellp(s)
        ctx = self.ctxp(f)
        res = []
        for k, (dy, dx) in enumerate(self.fps):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                pm = hc
                cpp = cp
            else:
                pm = F.max_pool2d(F.pad(hc, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1)), (dy, dx), stride=1)
                cpp = F.pad(cp, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            a = self.fpp[k](pm) + ctx
            vs = []
            for i in range(dy):
                for j in range(dx):
                    u = F.relu(cpp[:, :, i:i + Y, j:j + X] + a)
                    vs.append(F.relu(self.w2[k](u)))
            v = torch.stack(vs, 0)
            ag = torch.cat([v.amax(0), v.amin(0), v.mean(0)], dim=1)
            res.append(self.outs[k](F.relu(self.agg[k](ag))))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([s.mean((2, 3)), s.amax((2, 3)), f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.95, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

CF = 48
HK = 16
H1 = 48
H2 = 24
AG = 32
TW = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        n = len(self.fps)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(C, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, CF, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.hcode = nn.Conv2d(CF, HK, 1)
        self.cellp = nn.Conv2d(CF, H1, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(CF, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.ctxp = nn.Conv2d(TW, H1, 1)
        self.fpp = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HK, H1, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.w2 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H1, H2, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.agg = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * H2, AG, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(AG, 1, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * (CF + TW), 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        hc = self.hcode(s)
        cp = self.cellp(s)
        ctx = self.ctxp(f)
        res = []
        for k, (dy, dx) in enumerate(self.fps):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                pm = hc
                cpp = cp
            else:
                pm = F.max_pool2d(F.pad(hc, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1)), (dy, dx), stride=1)
                cpp = F.pad(cp, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            a = self.fpp[k](pm) + ctx
            vs = []
            for i in range(dy):
                for j in range(dx):
                    u = F.relu(cpp[:, :, i:i + Y, j:j + X] + a)
                    vs.append(F.relu(self.w2[k](u)))
            v = torch.stack(vs, 0)
            ag = torch.cat([v.amax(0), v.amin(0), v.mean(0)], dim=1)
            res.append(self.outs[k](F.relu(self.agg[k](ag))))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([s.mean((2, 3)), s.amax((2, 3)), f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.02, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

CF = 48
HK = 16
H1 = 48
H2 = 24
AG = 32
TW = 32
DONE_BIAS = -3.0


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        n = len(self.fps)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(C, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, CF, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.hcode = nn.Conv2d(CF, HK, 1)
        self.cellp = nn.Conv2d(CF, H1, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(CF, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(TW, TW, 3, padding=1)
        self.ctxp = nn.Conv2d(TW, H1, 1)
        self.fpp = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HK, H1, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.w2 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H1, H2, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.agg = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * H2, AG, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(AG, 1, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * (CF + TW), 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        nn.init.constant_(self.done_head.bias, DONE_BIAS)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        hc = self.hcode(s)
        cp = self.cellp(s)
        ctx = self.ctxp(f)
        res = []
        for k, (dy, dx) in enumerate(self.fps):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                pm = hc
                cpp = cp
            else:
                pm = F.max_pool2d(F.pad(hc, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1)), (dy, dx), stride=1)
                cpp = F.pad(cp, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            a = self.fpp[k](pm) + ctx
            vs = []
            for i in range(dy):
                for j in range(dx):
                    u = F.relu(cpp[:, :, i:i + Y, j:j + X] + a)
                    vs.append(F.relu(self.w2[k](u)))
            v = torch.stack(vs, 0)
            ag = torch.cat([v.amax(0), v.amin(0), v.mean(0)], dim=1)
            res.append(self.outs[k](F.relu(self.agg[k](ag))))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([s.mean((2, 3)), s.amax((2, 3)), f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.95, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
K = 16
HD = 256


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        YX = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(COL + WIDTH, K, 1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(K * YX, HD)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(HD, int(spec.n_place))
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * (COL + WIDTH) + HD, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        z = torch.cat([s, f], dim=1)
        r = F.relu(self.red(z)).flatten(1)
        h = F.relu(self.fc1(r))
        place = self.fc2(h)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([z.mean((2, 3)), z.amax((2, 3)), h], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.95, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        YX = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.tok = nn.Linear(YX, YX)
        self.chm = nn.Conv2d(COL + WIDTH, WIDTH, 1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * (COL + WIDTH), 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        z0 = torch.cat([s, x], dim=1)
        B, Cc, Y, X = z0.shape
        t = F.relu(self.tok(z0.reshape(B, Cc, Y * X)).reshape(B, Cc, Y, X))
        f = F.relu(x + self.chm(t))
        f = F.relu(f + self.c2(f))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([z0.mean((2, 3)), f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)[:, :2 * (COL + WIDTH)])
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

If actions are transposed relative to obs, this should beat 0 clearly and probably outperform A and B, since it keeps full conv structure. If it stays at 0, transposition is not the twist.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.95, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.sq = int(spec.Y) == int(spec.X)
        fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head_a = PoolHead(COL + WIDTH, fps, PROJ, HID)
        self.head_b = PoolHead(COL + WIDTH, [(b, a) for a, b in fps], PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * (COL + WIDTH), 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        z = torch.cat([s, f], dim=1)
        place = self.head_a(z)
        if self.sq:
            zt = z.transpose(2, 3).contiguous()
            place = place + self.head_b(zt)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([z.mean((2, 3)), z.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds, so for now we only know that the task is hard under this budget. Two bottlenecks seem likely. (1) The default recipe gets only about 32 PPO updates of 4,096 samples each. A smaller batch with 3 epochs gives about 83 updates and about 30% more samples at the same compute. (2) Perception. A correct placement needs the landing level, which is the highest column under the footprint, to match the lowest missing target cell in every covered column, with no target cells sealed underneath. The starting network mixes neighbouring columns with 3x3 convolutions before it pools over the footprint, which blurs the clean per-column height signals it needs. This round tests the recipe alone, then two changes on top of that same recipe: a column-feature skip into the footprint head, and a head that scores each (anchor, layer) pair separately and keeps the best layer. Results are 2-seed means, and seed luck can swing them, so I'll read small differences with care.
analyses.2: Every trial so far scores 0.000, both on dev and in training (train_success_last10pct is also 0). Seed noise gives no signal here, and changing only the architecture (column skip, per-layer scoring) did nothing at about 150k steps. The likeliest limit is the amount of experience. An exact build needs many correct placements in a row over 257 actions. The compute budget is charged per sample per PPO epoch, not per minibatch. So ppo_epochs=1 roughly triples the samples (about 426k steps), and more minibatches add gradient steps at no compute cost. This round mainly tests the recipe: (A) the baseline net with 1 epoch and many samples, (B) the same recipe plus cheap structural inputs (the legal-action mask as feature planes, and a column skip), and (C) 2 epochs with 64 small minibatches and almost no entropy. If all three stay at 0, the bottleneck is not sample volume, and either the policy-head design or a hidden quirk of the world needs attention.
analyses.3: All six trials scored 0 on both seeds, and training success was also 0. That covers more updates, 1 to 3 epochs, up to about 400k samples, a column-feature skip, mask planes and per-layer scoring. Neither recipe nor sample volume changed anything, so the agent probably never learns to place correct bricks reliably enough to finish a whole build. A correct placement must satisfy, for every footprint cell: the target has that cell at the brick's landing layer, and the column has no missing cells below that layer. The landing layer depends on the whole footprint (its maximum height), but the check is per cell. The current head pools once and then applies a 1x1 MLP, so it cannot express "pool, send the result back to each cell, check each cell, pool again". All three candidates use a head that does exactly that. Across them I vary epochs and samples, and exploration together with the risk of collapsing onto DONE.
analyses.4: All 9 trials scored 0 on dev and 0 on training success, across every recipe (1 to 3 epochs, 150k to 400k steps, different entropy and gamma settings) and every head (pooled, per-layer, landing-paired). An anti-collapse DONE bias also changed nothing. This looks like a systematic mismatch, not seed noise or tuning. The task warns that the world may not behave as described. Every head so far assumes that the action index a % (Y*X) = y*X + x matches the obs grid. If actions were transposed, flipped or permuted relative to obs, translation-equivariant conv heads could not line up their logits with the features, and every trial would fail. In this last round I test that idea three ways: a fully learned dense action head that can handle any layout, a token-mixing trunk that can learn any spatial remap but keeps footprint pooling, and an explicit dual head that scores both the normal and the transposed layout.
